weather._doc: States: clear, rain, snow (story 12.1). Rain makes puddles (surface override puddle). Snow, only in the winter part of the day, drifts flakes and covers a share of open tiles with snow (grip 0.5) of which iceShare become ice (grip 0.15, very slippery); when it stops they melt away oldest first. The season comes from the day phase (data/day.json): autumn rain and leaves, winter snow and ice, spring and summer dry and bright.
